segments.text: Thar's the off-roader that'll leave the Gypsy in the dust!
Packing 152 P-S of power, this Thar means business, but the best bit is coming!
With 320 N-m of torque, you'll be scaling mountains in no time, thanks to its 2-litre engine!
And when things get tough, its 4x4 system's got your back!

Estimated price? 10.32 to 17.80 lakh, but trust me, the LXT RWD Diesel around ₹12.99 lakh is the sweet spot - you get a 10.25-inch infotainment screen, cruise control, keyless entry, and a rear camera, all without the 4x4 premium!
The Thar: because who needs a gym when you can just drive up a mountain?
Which Thar variant would you choose? Follow for more!
